profile.headline: Sr Fullstack Developer
profile.summary: I am a Fullstack Java developer with more than 8 years of experience on industry, experience Design and Building websites and web applications. I specialize in JavaScript frameworks and libraries like(React and Angular) and have professional experience working with Java Core and SQL and NoSQL DB.

positions.title: Sr Fullstack Developer
positions.description:
As a Full stack developer, worked on several projects with Sintesys to create and develop web application using front ReactJS + Redux for the state management, and integration with Java components and webservices.

•Serves as the senior-level lead developing Using J2EE Technology architecture, using JSF Primefaces framework, webservices with google cloud computing, and MongoDB NoSQL
•Designing and developing Custom Technical Components, Definition and design of fancy layout web pages, liaison between IT partners. This involved updating content, making sure that the website's code is compatible with various browsers, with Bootstrap and JavaScript Technology
•Develop UI, using HTML 5 wireframes, UX concepts, CSS3, JavaScript, React.js with Redux using webpack and Grunt as build tools, Jest/Enzyme for Unit Testing, with responsive design.

positions.title: Lead / Fullstack java Developer
positions.description:
CITI Banamex is a Financial Group was purchased by Citigroup. SIC / RINO Project (Interface Modification, Report Adjustment, Daily Batch Process) This project was an improvement and maintenance initiative for the application, which is a transaction reporter, that provides access to the brokers to analyze the data and be able to deliver the daily report to Banxico, our team It was in charge of modifying the user interface, as well as improving the information fields in the database, and ensuring the correct operation to display the data well, and automate the processes and transactions of  application modules.

•Analyzing the business requirement and created a proposal to the client.
•Created documentation based on the CITI Banamex methodology (FRD / BRD)
•Generation Functional Design templates to improve their actual look and feel
•Develop and change the user interface using Spring MVC, HTML 5, CSS3, JavaScript, Angular 4 and 5/React.js (For applications that was avoid to the technology upgrade)
